search.snippet: Mushroom spores can be planted at the mushroom patch at level 53 Farming to yield six bittercap mushrooms. The only mushroom patch in game can be found west of Canifis (Fairy ring CKS). Successfully harvesting these mushrooms is a task in the hard tier of the Morytania diary.

search.snippet: Players with 53 Farming can grow mushrooms from a mushroom spore in the mushroom patch just west of Canifis (close to the fairy ring CKS). This takes about four hours to grow and yields six mushrooms.

search.snippet: Mushroom spores are used in the Farming skill and require level 53 in the skill to grow them. They are planted at the mushroom patch west of Canifis. Six mushrooms can be harvested. Successfully doing so is a hard task in the Morytania achievement diary. You cannot pay a farmer to protect this patch. The community for Old School RuneScape discussion on Reddit.
